nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, we're family. You're like my sister. I'll do whatever it takes to make sure you get into Kingston with me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... Let's scale back our expectations to something a little more state school. I'm definitely not Kingston material.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, you'd hate having me at Kingston. We'd probably be roommates, and you know that would make us `both` miserable...
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, you'd hate having me at Kingston. We'd probably be roommates, and you know that would make us [color=#3b78e2][i]both[/i][/color] miserable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only if you forget to pick up all your clothes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See? I hate you as a roommate already.
$ZOE laughs, and it cheers Sam up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, fine. Maybe not Kingston. But you can definitely get into Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now `that` sounds more my style...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] sounds more my style...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I could afford it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's got to be a way we can help you get into college. It's not hopeless. There are other loans we can help Aunt Cathy apply for...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you're talented! There must be a ton of scholarships for you to get!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? A scholarship for what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are scholarships for everything under the sun! We could do swimming...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but now that Emily Kessler's in this school, I don't think I'm going to be winning any swimming scholarships.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have `other` skills, Sam. And I know just the person to ask!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] skills, Sam. And I know just the person to ask!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're going to see Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee is... Insane.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, as the school counselor, unfortunately, she's the only one who has all the information we need...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because... Because you're already on track.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have cheerleading and Social Chair and baking, and the recruiter from Kingston University practically told you that you'd be accepted if you applied!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: While I'm just struggling to get into college in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why should that matter? That's just the stuff I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do plenty of things! You're on the swim team, aren't you? And didn't you just become captain last year?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, yes, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You seemed really distracted by the Paige and Owen stuff, and I didn't want to unload all my stuff on you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, it's not your fault, and you can't really do anything about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I admire your independence and your willingness to face this alone, but sometimes you're too stubborn for your own good.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously, you could have talked to me any time. Especially about something as important as college!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now are you going to tell me what's going on with you or what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen you look so depressed in my life!
Sam tries to tell $ZOE about her college problem, but instead launches into what happened with Nick that morning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...And he called me `Sara.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And he called me [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He called you `Sara?`
nodes.text_bbcode: He called you [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes. What did he say next? Did he apologize? Did he explain?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He tried to apologize, but I accidentally... Fled. I don't know! My brain just kind of shut down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, it's fine. It's just one more crappy thing to think about other than...
She trails off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other than what?
Sam shifts her weight from foot to foot then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Remember that loan my mom was applying for? It fell through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The one you were counting on to pay for college? When?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right after the Sectionals game...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you waited this long to tell me?!

options.label: I didn't want to ask for help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I already `told` you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, I already [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn was so devastated by the loss of her mother's camera that she just left Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Luckily, she was accepted into this elite school across town, but...
$ZOE's shoulders slump, and Sam feels bad making her cousin relive the sore memory.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't stop her. I feel so responsible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was my fault she was in the Art Showcase in the first place. I couldn't protect her, and I feel like I've totally failed her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, $ZOE looks so depressed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't meant to be such a downer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. I'm glad Lindsay got into trouble over it though. She's been suspended for two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Although a `two week suspension` is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.
nodes.text_bbcode: Although a [color=#3b78e2][i]two week suspension[/i][/color] is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, it's going to make cheerleading practice super awkward when she gets back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, `Lindsay.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, [color=#3b78e2][i]Lindsay.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, I've never heard you say anyone's name like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Probably because I've never been more disgusted by someone in my life!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe she destroyed Autumn's camera!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's been suspended. Principal McCormick made sure of that the day right after the Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Although a `two week suspension` is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.
nodes.text_bbcode: Although a [color=#3b78e2][i]two week suspension[/i][/color] is too short for all the harm she did to Autumn. It doesn't feel like enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it's something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I was hoping that'd be enough to lure Autumn back, but... She still left. Granted, it's for a better school with better resources... But still.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever then. It seems like that's a win for Autumn. She'll be happier away from Lindsay and in a great place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I'll have to be happy with that, I guess. Autumn is happy, and Lindsay is suspended.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Congrats to Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good riddance to Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Except that when she comes back, it's going to make cheerleading super awkward... But I'll deal with that later.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You called me `Sara.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You called me [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick thinks back to the seconds before the door closed and winces.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Did I?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure there's a perfectly good reason I said the name of my ex-girlfriend instead of your name...
But before he can say anything else, Sam storms off.
You are now playing as Sam.
Later that day, at lunch...
Sam avoids the topic of college while she and $ZOE go from bulletin board to bulletin board, changing out the flyers in each.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you don't want to talk about anything? You're awfully quiet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, no! I'm `great`... How's it going with you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, no! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color]... How's it going with you?

nodes.text: $ZOE gives her cousin a skeptical look, but continues switching out a flyer advertising the Art Showcase from last month and puts in another flyer about an upcoming play by the drama club.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be a honest, I'm glad you're here. I'm really bummed out that the Art Showcase didn't go as well as I wanted it to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... Whatever happened to...
Nick catches the door before it shuts completely on Sam.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you see that? I caught the door like some kind of... Superhero! Who'd have thought...
He trails off, his relief tempered by the distressed look on Sam's face.
Nick tries to catch the door, but his grip slips! He fumbles and watches the door close on Sam!
It hits Sam's arm, but she doesn't even blink. Casually, she steps outside, mute.
The distressed look on her face makes him freeze.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you okay? Please tell me you're okay! If you're in shock, blink once.
She shakes her head.

It hits Sam's arm, but she doesn't even blink. Casually, she steps outside, mute.
The distressed look on her face makes him freeze.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you okay? Please tell me you're okay! If you're in shock, blink once.
She shakes her head.
Paralyzed, Nick just stands there, watching the door close on Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If I remember, you were the one who brought up studying for the S.E.T.s two weeks ago when you were concerned that $ZOE was going to...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How did you put it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: 'Kick your sorry butt' on the test.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't say 'sorry'. And that was two weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... What changed? You've been acting... Strange.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No I haven't! Strange is... Uh... How Ben and Emily are gone all the time ever since they made up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not strange. They're making out on the roof.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Bad example! What about Owen? He's been acting strange ever since the Sectionals game against Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a difference between `strange` and `mopey.` `Mopey` is how Owen's been since he found out Paige is under lockdown at the Monarch Prep detention center.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's a difference between [color=#e23b3b][i]strange[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]mopey.[/i][/color] [color=#e23b3b][i]Mopey[/i][/color] is how Owen's been since he found out Paige is under lockdown at the Monarch Prep detention center.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Strange` is what you are since the night of the basketball game. So what's up?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Strange[/i][/color] is what you are since the night of the basketball game. So what's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I just don't see the point of studying all the time for the S.E.T.s. They're just a bunch of stupid standardized tests.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I agree that they're stupid. But for whatever reason, colleges put a lot of stock in them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And we should probably take them a little more seriously right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen to yourself... Nerd much?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I prefer intelligent hipster who ironically believes in the institution of college. College is where all the hipster blogs say I'll really 'blossom.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you just put air quotes around 'blossom'?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I did say 'ironically.'
Sam rolls her eyes at him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But seriously, you can tell me what's wrong. I can tell you're acting funny. And not in the funny ha-ha way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about college.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nervous about where you're going to go?
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My mom got a letter in the mail the other day about a loan we'd applied for...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa, that's a lot more serious a conversation than I thought we'd be having.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Should I change the subject to lighten the mood?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam... Don't be angry. I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It turns out I'm not eligible. And that was the best loan I could have hoped to get.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There aren't other ways? Academic scholarships?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With my grades? No way. So I don't really have a way of getting funding for college.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which means that I'm not going away for college any time soon. Which `means` that all `this` doesn't matter.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means that I'm not going away for college any time soon. Which [color=#3b78e2][i]means[/i][/color] that all [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] doesn't matter.

nodes.text: She waves her hand over the S.E.T. preparation booklets.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just sucks because I thought I might have an opportunity to experience something special... And now it's gone...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure that's not true. There's got to be another way. Why don't you ask $ZOE about it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She's the Social Chair. I'm sure she knows other ways of getting funding...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to talk to $ZOE about it. She's all Little Miss Perfect, and she's definitely getting into a good college, and she has her life all planned out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, I didn't think you were the jealous type...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not jealousy... It's embarrassment. I don't want to talk to her about how hopelessly behind I am.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She's your cousin. She lives in your house. She's probably the person you `should` talk to about this.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's your cousin. She lives in your house. She's probably the person you [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] talk to about this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And on the bright side, if she's that on track, she probably has all the time in the world to help you. Which she will. Because she's your cousin...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And creepily nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, that's true.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Promise me you'll talk to her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure... I'll try to bring it up.
The bell warning the students that classes are about to start peals overhead. They gather their books.
Nick leads them out the double doors that open onto the main courtyard.
He walks through and holds the door open for Sam when a strong gust of cold wind catches Nick off guard. He loses his grip on the door handle, and the door begins to close!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh oh... `Sara!` Look out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh oh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara![/i][/color] Look out!

nodes.text: Nick jumps forward to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's try it and see.
Nick sets the timer on his phone for one minute.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready? Pencil's poised? Go!
They work on the questions from the standardized test booklet diligently for the next minute.
When the timer beeps, they sit up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How many did you answer?
Sam shows Nick her booklet... Only one question has been answered.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just one?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just one! But I did think of seven different ways to destroy my S.E.T. booklet! One involves Megan's butane torch!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd `you` do?
nodes.text_bbcode: How'd [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, four.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Let's face it. I'm going to suck at the S.E.T.s. And this just proves it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It doesn't prove anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It proves that I'm not as focused as everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: None of this matters anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really think that's going to make this more fun?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, try it before you knock it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If it's really bad, I'll knock `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If it's really bad, I'll knock [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick clears his throat and props the book up to read from it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.text: Wat eez ze ah ree ah of un sue kware eef ze side eez the sue kware voot of weigh tee vone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wat eez ze `ah ree ah` of un `sue kware` eef ze `side` eez the `sue kware voot` of `weigh tee vone`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wat eez ze [color=#e23b3b][i]ah ree ah[/i][/color] of un [color=#e23b3b][i]sue kware[/i][/color] eef ze [color=#e23b3b][i]side[/i][/color] eez the [color=#e23b3b][i]sue kware voot[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]weigh tee vone[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is the... Aria? Area! Of a sucker?
Sam gets halfway through the sentence before cracking up.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! Bzzt! Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha! What's the actual sentence?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What is the `area` of a `square` if the side is the `square root` of `eighty one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is the [color=#e23b3b][i]area[/i][/color] of a [color=#e23b3b][i]square[/i][/color] if the side is the [color=#e23b3b][i]square root[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]eighty one![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ohhhh!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How could you `not` get that?
nodes.text_bbcode: How could you [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because it's totally lame?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So? What's the answer?
Sam takes a long time thinking about it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's 81.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After all that, I get it wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh well... Who cares?
Sam and $ZOE practice lines, taking excerpts from the entire play to round out Sam's audition.
During the romantic balcony scene, Sam thinks of Zomebietown...

nodes.text: `O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O Romeo, Romeo! Wherefore art thou Romeo?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But my true love is grown to such excess... I cannot sum up sum of half my wealth...[/i][/color]

nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good! You know, Sam... I didn't know you were so talented.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: Well, it clearly makes you happy because that was `great!` I don't think we even have to do another round!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it clearly makes you happy because that was [color=#3b78e2][i]great![/i][/color] I don't think we even have to do another round!

nodes.text: Music to my ears...

nodes.text: I'm so excited to see the tryouts tomorrow. You'll blow everyone away!

nodes.text: I'll applaud to that.

nodes.text: Hey, she's great!

nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.text: So... Does that mean I'm in?

nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.text: Because... Your audition...

nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.text: Was awful!

nodes.text: What am I going to do now?

nodes.text: Hey.

args.text: They walk down the hallway to Ms. Lee's office...
And $ZOE almost runs into Owen on his way out!
Hi, Owen. Is everything all right? You didn't drop out of fifth period science, did you?
No... We're still lab partners if you were worried...
I just wanted some answers. About Paige.
Was Ms. Lee helpful? She has a tendency to be... Uh...
She must have been in a good mood. She was surprisingly helpful.
Almost `too` helpful actually. I don't think she's supposed to show me another student's file, but she seemed really distracted by a phone conversation with her, uh... Drooly Love Muffin?
In a way, it just confirms what I already knew. Paige is gone. It's official. She's at Monarch Prep... Permanently.
As long as she's there, and I'm on Whitford's 'Bad Boy' list, then I won't be seeing her anytime soon.
If her parents wanted to keep us apart, they chose the right place.
At least there are holidays. She has to come home for those! And you'll see her then.
I'm not sure about that. Her mother has a tendency to ship her off to exotic places...
I guess I'll figure it out.
If you need any help, let me know.
Owen nods, but his mouth is set in a grim line.
I'll see you around, $ZOE. Bye, Sam.
Sam waves until Owen turns a corner. Then she puts a hand on $ZOE's shoulder.
I'm sorry... You're going to what? Are you seriously trying to get Paige back into his life?
Then helping him find Paige isn't a good idea. You should be...
Throwing yourself at him!|Spending time away from him!
$ZOE... You like him. And he likes Paige. It's going to `kill` you to keep on hanging out with him if he's hung up on her.
Come on, don't you think it's a little silly to be following him around, helping him find Paige?
No! It's not silly to, uh... To help him. And it's definitely not silly to drive him to Monarch Prep to go see her...
I see what you're getting at... I'm putting myself in the danger zone, I know...
And you don't hang out in the danger zone because it's `dangerous.`
But I can't turn my back on him either, Sam. I failed Autumn... I'm not failing him.
Feelings aside, all I want right now is to be his friend.
Paige is finally out of the picture. There's no one else here to confuse him.
Now go put on your best sequined bikini and jump out at him from inside a cake!
Uh... What? Why? Who would `do` that?
Um... No one. Definitely not something I ever did for Colt...
The point is... This is your opportunity!
Don't be ridiculous... I can't tell him how I feel.
Because Owen `really` likes Paige. And he and I aren't as close as we used to be.
Whatever I'm feeling for him now... I'm keeping to myself.
Being coy and not sharing your feelings never works.
Isn't that how you and Nick got back together? By forcefully denying your feelings for him?
No! That's not the same. Nick tricked me.
He `tricked` you? Into admitting your feelings.
Yeah, with his pretty words and his effeminate glasses. I still can't believe the skinny jeans thing works for me.
But what am I saying? This is your chance!
No, it's not. Right now, I just want to be his friend. And I want to help.
And besides, we shouldn't even be talking about me right now... It's about you! So let's go talk to Ms. Lee!
Before Sam can protest, $ZOE knocks on Ms. Lee's door and heads inside.
$ZOE and Sam walk into the office where Ms. Lee sits behind her desk, talking on her cell phone.
Ms. Lee holds up one finger and smiles into her phone.
I really `have` to go, Bruno. You be good now!
She ends her call, clears her throat, and turns to Sam and $ZOE.
Chloe! Jan! What are you doing here?
Oh, who cares about something so silly as names? Come in, sit down!
$ZOE and Sam take seats in her visitor's chairs.
I'm also doing very well, thank you for asking!
My mother told me that this day would `never` come. She used to say, 'Louisa, your life will never be fulfilling unless you become a wife and mother'...
But I skipped a step and adopted!
No! Are you crazy? Babies are just loud, crying factories! I can't stand crying.
That's why I adopted a dog! He's the love of my life.
Is that who you were talking to on the phone?
Yes. Isn't he precious? Of course, he can't really pick up the phone. He's a `dog!`
But I know listening to my voice on the answering machine calms his little dog heart down.
Uh, Ms. Lee, we're here to ask you a couple questions. Sam's applying for college--
College? At your age? Aren't you a bit... Over the hill?
How old do you think I am exactly?
Never you mind. There's all sorts at college. Or so I've been told.
Sam mouths 'What does that mean?' to $ZOE. $ZOE shrugs while Ms. Lee taps keys on the computer at her desk and pulls up Sam's file.
Ah, yes... Sam, you're the captain of the swim team and a mediocre student with no other accolades to her name...
We're `here` to ask about `scholarships` to help Sam out during the application process.
Oh, we have plenty of those!
Ms. Lee types into her computer until she finds the scholarship listings.
Let's see here... Luckily, there are thousands of academic scholarships that Sam can apply for, and a few for our more `remedial` students that she might even stand a chance at getting...
Sadly, all of the deadlines have already passed.
But luckily, there are several student-specific scholarships left.
It means only special students can qualify for them, and it's usually due to a specific quality. For instance, Amanda Applebee qualified for Redheads Against Books.
And Hector got a special scholarship for promising to exclusively use Punk Moose Mousse in his hair for the rest of his college career.
No! These are very serious scholarships. For instance, the Walrus Face Scholarship is very prestigious and hard to win, but they offer a generous amount.
For those whose faces look like a walrus's.
There's Stamp Fancy's Stamp Scholarship... You don't happen to have an obsession with stamps precipitated by a traumatic event in your childhood, do you?
Oh well. There's the Pi Scholarship... That's for people whose GPA is exactly a 3.14...
Didn't you just say that one?
No. The second one is for people who love to eat pie.
How many pie-eating competitions have you won?
Then you don't really like pie all that much... Do you?
Instead of reading through every listing, can we search by my traits or something?
Excellent! I'm glad you thought of it. It's like a game! Why don't you give me a set of unique traits that you have, and I'll see what I can find?
Oh yeah... That's a `good` quality in a woman these days...
I don't know if that's your `best` quality...
Hey, there's a scholarship for a `walrus face.`
Or... At least that's what everyone mistakes my anger for...
Hmmm... Interesting qualities. They sound... Familiar, like something I've read before...
She pulls up a page on her computer.
Ah, yes, the Shakespearean Society has a scholarship for `actors...`
I've never acted... But I can try.
There are some requirements, of course.
You have to be willing to study performing arts in the college of your choosing...
If it'll get me to college, I can do that.
Second, to qualify, you must write an essay about a performance you've done.
A little harder, but I'm sure I can do something by the end of the year.
And lastly, they're only offering it to actors or actresses who have performed in a production of `Romeo and Juliet.`
It's going to be hard to find a school or community center doing that play. I can't do that...
$ZOE pulls out a flyer from her bag. Sam recognizes it as one that $ZOE's been putting up on all the bulletin boards.
The drama club. They're performing Romeo and Juliet. And their tryouts are tomorrow!
No, Sam... Sometimes things just work out! Come on! We've got to get you ready for tryouts!
No need to be snippy. I'll find something. Even if Sam isn't `strictly` qualified for it...
Her long nails clatter on the keyboard as she searches...
There is something. The Shakespearean Society has a scholarship for `actors...`
Great news! I have `nothing` for you!
You won't have to go through the trouble of applying for college if you can't pay for it.
Sam is none of those qualities. She's smart, and creative, and intelligent... Is there anything for `that?`

It's dinnertime in the 'Butterfly Detention Center' of Monarch Prep...
Paige sits unhappily and alone at a table with a white-linen tablecloth on it, buttering a fresh French baguette with a dull knife.

...We're sorry. This account has insufficient funds to make an outgoing call. Please refill your account and try again...
